content.comment_body: Did anyone find a solution to this? I'm encountering the same issue where the page appears, but no data is visible.

This topic is closed because the question was posted twice. A similar thread titled [product_name weekly timer only partly working] is available in the [product_name - Projects] section. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Several users report that the [product_name] Web Editor page loads but does not display any data. The problem persists for multiple users and no solution is offered in these responses, indicating ongoing difficulties with data acquisition or visualization on the editor page.
